import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, c, f, rev;
        Edge(int to, int c, int f, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.c = c;
            this.f = f;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static ArrayList<Edge>[] g;
    static int[] d, ptr;
    static int s, t, n;
    static Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();

    static void addEdge(int v, int u, int cap) {
        g[v].add(new Edge(u, cap, 0, 0));
        g[u].add(new Edge(v, 0, 0, 0));
        g[v].get(g[v].size() - 1).rev = g[u].size() - 1;
        g[u].get(g[u].size() - 1).rev = g[v].size() - 1;
    }

    static boolean buildLevNet() {
        Arrays.fill(d, INF);
        d[s] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : g[v]) {
                int to = e.to;
                int cf = e.c - e.f;
                if (d[to] == INF && cf > 0) {
                    d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                    q.add(to);
                }
            }
        }
        return d[t] != INF;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int curFlow) {
        if (v == t) return curFlow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            Edge e = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.to;
            int cf = e.c - e.f;
            if (d[to] == d[v] + 1 && cf > 0) {
                int add = dfs(to, Math.min(curFlow, cf));
                if (add != 0) {
                    e.f += add;
                    g[to].get(e.rev).f -= add;
                    return add;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinica() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (buildLevNet()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int add;
            while ((add = dfs(s, INF)) != 0) flow += add;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static char[][] a, b;
    static int[][][][] dst;
    static int tbad;
    static int px, py;
    static final int[] X = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] Y = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static boolean check(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n && a[x][y] != 'Y' && a[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfs(int xs, int ys) {
        int[][] cur = dst[xs][ys];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(cur[i], INF);
        cur[xs][ys] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> go = new ArrayDeque<>();
        go.add(new int[]{xs, ys});
        while (!go.isEmpty()) {
            int[] v = go.poll();
            int vx = v[0], vy = v[1];
            if (cur[vx][vy] == dst[px][py][vx][vy] && (px != xs || py != ys)) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = vx + X[k];
                int ny = vy + Y[k];
                if (check(nx, ny) && cur[nx][ny] == INF &&
                    cur[vx][vy] + 1 <= dst[px][py][nx][ny]) {
                    cur[nx][ny] = cur[vx][vy] + 1;
                    go.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        tbad = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        a = new char[n][n];
        b = new char[n][n];
        px = 0; py = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') { px = i; py = j; }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        dst = new int[n][n][n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++)
                        dst[i][j][k][l] = INF;

        bfs(px, py);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                dst[px][py][i][j] = Math.min(dst[px][py][i][j], tbad);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (check(i, j)) bfs(i, j);

        int maxV = 2 * n * n + 5;
        g = new ArrayList[maxV];
        for (int i = 0; i < maxV; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        d = new int[maxV];
        ptr = new int[maxV];
        s = 0;
        t = 2 * n * n + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] != '0') addEdge(s, i * n + j + 1, a[i][j] - '0');
                if (b[i][j] != '0') addEdge(i * n + j + 1 + n * n, t, b[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (!check(i, j)) continue;
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                        if (!check(i1, j1)) continue;
                        if (dst[i][j][i1][j1] <= dst[px][py][i1][j1]) {
                            addEdge(i * n + j + 1, i1 * n + j1 + 1 + n * n, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinica());
        sc.close();
    }
}
